rules.name: A valid continuation resumes the active move quickly after a controlled pullback or liquidity reaction
rules.setupAnchor: Price retraces into the respected half of a range, imbalance, order block, breaker, or recent liquidity sweep area
rules.confirmationTrigger: Price reacts fast, closes through the opposing candle series, and prints immediate displacement in the bias direction
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The continuation swing becomes protected once the reaction closes through the opposing candle series and the new high or low holds
rules.invalidationCondition: Price drifts sideways, trades deeper through the anchor zone, or breaks the newly protected swing before expansion resumes
rules.targetLogic: Primary objective is the next external liquidity pool or prior session or daily objective in the direction of bias
exceptions: Grinding recoveries are lower quality than one-to-three-candle reactions
Late continuations after a higher-timeframe objective is already met should be avoided
machineChecks: Require active bias direction before continuation logic is enabled
Require reaction close beyond the opposing candle series
Flag low-quality setups when recovery takes more than three candles
ambiguityNotes: Anchor-zone ranking still needs explicit precedence rules

rules.name: Continuation quality improves when price respects the correct half of the range around equilibrium
rules.setupAnchor: Mark equilibrium from wick high to wick low on the chosen range or candle
rules.confirmationTrigger: Bullish continuation holds the upper half of the range and bearish continuation holds the lower half, then lower timeframe structure confirms in the same direction
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: A protected swing formed while price respects the correct half of the range is stronger than a continuation formed after deep range violation
rules.invalidationCondition: Price closes through the wrong side of equilibrium and fails to reclaim it before the next continuation attempt
rules.targetLogic: Use equilibrium as the divider for continuation intent and combine it with higher-timeframe targets or standard deviation projections
exceptions: Respect does not require an exact midpoint touch
A candle with a large opposing wick weakens continuation quality even if equilibrium initially holds
machineChecks: Compute equilibrium as midpoint of wick high and wick low
Track whether closes remain on the respected half of the range
Demote continuation quality when opposing wick ratio expands materially
ambiguityNotes: Equilibrium tolerance band is not yet numeric

rules.name: Order blocks, breaker blocks, and imbalances are valid continuation anchors only after structure confirms
rules.setupAnchor: A fair value gap, order block, breaker block, or swept high or low forms inside the active directional narrative
rules.confirmationTrigger: After the anchor forms, price closes through the opposing candle series and confirms a new protected swing in the bias direction
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Continuation order blocks and breaker blocks only matter after the swing created by the reaction is structurally protected
rules.invalidationCondition: The anchor is revisited without confirmation, or the swing that validated it fails immediately after entry
rules.targetLogic: Enter on the retest of the validated anchor and target the next external high or low rather than small internal range objectives
exceptions: A breaker without a qualifying sweep is weaker unless paired with SMT divergence
If no protected swing forms, treat the anchor as unconfirmed and stand aside
machineChecks: Separate anchor detection from continuation confirmation
Require the validating close through the opposing candle series before entry eligibility
Allow optional SMT divergence as a secondary qualifier for breaker structures
ambiguityNotes: Order block and breaker proxies still need stricter first-pass formulas

rules.name: Most failed continuations are consolidation, completed liquidity objectives, or late entries after the move is spent
rules.setupAnchor: A continuation candidate forms after a pullback, sweep, or minor structure shift
rules.confirmationTrigger: Quality is accepted only when price expands cleanly instead of rotating across a local range and only when higher-timeframe objectives remain open
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: If the supposed continuation cannot protect the new swing quickly, it should be treated as range behavior or phase transition risk
rules.invalidationCondition: Price rotates across the local range, sweeps a short-term target and stalls, or forms after the higher-timeframe objective has already been reached
rules.targetLogic: Pass on weak setups and wait for the next clean continuation after the sweep or after the range resolves
exceptions: Waiting one more candle is often enough to separate real expansion from range manipulation
Missing a move is preferable to entering after the objective is complete
machineChecks: Detect local range rotation before approving continuation entries
Block continuation entries once the higher-timeframe target has been marked as reached
Add a one-more-candle filter before final entry approval

openQuestions: What is the best first-pass formula for order block and breaker block detection without overfitting to one educator's drawing style?
How should the project rank overlapping continuation anchors when equilibrium, a sweep, and an imbalance all align in the same area?
